products.name: Krita AI
products.note: Open-source digital art; local AI plugins; no cloud dependency; community governance

profile_text.body:
The Krita Foundation is a non-profit, open-source foundation that develops and maintains Krita, a digital painting and art application distributed under community governance. The foundation's website describes the project as oriented toward artists, with development driven by its open-source community rather than a commercial entity.

The foundation's AI-related offering is tracked as Krita AI, which the site positions as an open-source digital art tool with local AI plugins and no cloud dependency. This approach means AI features run on the user's own hardware rather than through external services, consistent with the foundation's community-governed, non-commercial structure.

No litigation, patent filings, MCP servers, or SEC records are associated with the Krita Foundation in the available data.
